data.fund_name: ICICI Prudential Retirement Fund - Hybrid Aggressive Plan
data.investment_objective: An open ended hybrid scheme predominantly investing in equity and equity related securities to generate capital appreciation. The scheme may also invest in Debt, Gold/Gold ETF/units of REITs & InvITs and such other asset classes as may be permitted from time to time for income generation / wealth creation. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
• Equity & Equity related instruments = 65% - 100% 
• Debt and money market instruments = 0% - 35% 
• Gold, Gold ETFs and INVITs and any other security permitted by SEBI from time to time(subject to applicable limits)
